item.title: Early Music Festival to host European Tour this weekend
item.description: PORT TOWNSEND — The Salish Sea Early Music Festival will present “European Tour: Italy, Scotland and Ukraine” at 2 p.m. Sunday.

item.title: Golden Shoals duo to play at Rainshadow Concerts
item.description: PORT TOWNSEND — Golden Shoals will perform at 7:30 p.m. Sunday for Rainshadow Concerts.

item.title: Sequim photographer Ross Hamilton dies at age 83
item.description: Friends remember him as a light for the community

item.title: Clallam County beaches closed to shellfish harvesting
item.description: PORT ANGELES — Clallam County beaches have been closed for recreational shellfish harvesting for all species due to high paralytic shellfish poison levels in samples sent to the state Department of Health.

item.title: Clallam Transit approves service and route changes
Port Angeles City Council hears presentations on homelessness
1B BASKETBALL PLAYOFFS: Neah Bay teams sweep in tournament openers
item.description: NEAH BAY — The Neah Bay boys and girls both moved into the semifinals of the 1B Tri-district tournament, with each team needing just one more win to qualify for the 1B state tournament.

item.title: PREP PLAYOFF BASKETBALL: Port Angeles boys dropped by Clover Park
item.description: LAKEWOOD — The Port Angeles boys basketball team had trouble handling the ball against Clover Park’s pressure, especially in the third quarter, and lost its second-round District 3 2A tournament game 64-43.

item.title: PREP BASKETBALL PLAYOFFS: Sequim rally comes up short against Bainbridge
item.description: BAINBRIDGE — Sequim started strong, suffered a lull before the Wolves played themselves back into the contest, but ultimately didn’t have the energy to complete a double-digit comeback in a 77-66 West Central District 3 Tournament boys basketball quarterfinal on Wednesday night.

item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL PLAYOFFS: Roughriders fire on all cylinders while crushing Orting 63-11
item.description: PORT ANGELES — In the Port Angeles girls’ most dominating win of the season, the Roughriders served notice during their District 3 2A tournament opener that their defense will be a force to deal with for the other teams in the district.
